title: PIXL 8000 Blueberry Sour Razz Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blueberry Sour Razz offers a twist on classic berry blends with a tangy edge. The juicy depth of Blueberry is sharpened by a sour Raspberry layer for a vape that’s bright, sweet and tart. The pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and comes attached to a 10ml refill reservoir. When paired with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this setup provides up to 8000 puffs and reliably smooth flavour thanks to mesh coil technology. MTL-friendly, draw-activated, and effortlessly low-maintenance — just pop the pod into the device, tap twice for Boost Mode, and enjoy a tangy, fruit-filled vape. One of the more vibrant options in the PIXL 8000 range.
